_comment: Metro and vernacular regions of United Kingdom: a curated dataset (CC BY 4.0, see datasets/LICENSE.md). packbuild.regions turns it into src/placewise/constants/countries/regions.py for location search (python -m packbuild.regions), and packbuild.regions_layer into the country pack's `regions` polygon layer. Fields: id (stable, region:<slug>), short_name (what a parsed place's `region` holds), name, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), admin1 (every subdivision the region reaches into, by its ISO 3166-2 suffix), aliases, kind (metro: a statistical metro area; official-planning: an area a public body plans or governs as one; vernacular: a name in common use, drawn with official units), members (the official units whose union is the region, as ids in the country pack: census:<county GEOID>, statcan:<CDUID, CSDUID or CMAPUID>, pin:<PIN code>; the pack build fails if one is missing), districts (India only: the districts the definition names, as the India Post directory spells them; members are exactly the PIN areas filed under them), definition (title and url of the source that defines the region), search_as (optional: location search reads this region's names as that region, and has no entry for it), principal_cities (well-known member cities and their admin1, so a parsed city can be placed in the region offline), city_aliases (other names of member cities -> the name placewise prefers) and notes (why the region is drawn as it is).

regions.name: Greater London

definition.title: Greater London Authority: the 32 London boroughs and the City of London

regions.notes: The 32 London boroughs and the City of London, England. No members yet: there is no United Kingdom pack to draw them from.
